study type: Cross-sectional online studies with retrospective data collection
outcome: Retrospectively reported process of labor and birth (interventions, duration of birth, place of birth)
Birth-related criteria (place of birth, epidural anesthesia, C-sections)
cohort: A total of 515 mothers participated across three online studies, retrospectively reporting on their birth experiences and mindsets.
finding: The birth process experienced by women and their mental representations of birth (birth-related mindset) are closely related, with the mindset being associated with birth-related criteria and moderating the relationship between C-section and birth experience.
mod_finding: C-sections were associated with the birth-related mindset, and the birth-related mindset moderated the relationship between C-section and birth experience.
cross-section timing: The studies were performed at a single point in time, retrospectively asking mothers about their past birth experiences.
